overview.description: The goal-strategy service is a sophisticated SMART goal processing system that transforms vague user goals into actionable, time-bound objectives
overview.architecturePattern: LLM-driven microservice with conversational state management

smartGoalProcessorV1.description: Original implementation with pattern-based detection and manual scoring

smartGoalProcessorV2.description: Refactored LLM-first architecture delegating heavy lifting to OpenAI

conversationalStateManager.description: Manages conversation flow and UI state recommendations

unifiedGoalProcessor.description: Comprehensive goal processing with milestone and task generation
keyFeatures: Single LLM call for multiple operations

goalTranslation.description: Converts raw goals to SMART format

clarification.description: Process clarification answers to improve goals

problems: Complex state machine with 7+ conversation phases
Heavy metadata tracking for each conversation turn
UI recommendation system tightly coupled with conversation state
conversationFlow.impact: Difficult to maintain and debug conversation flows

problems: Inconsistent scoring between v1 and v2 implementations
Pattern detection potentially overriding LLM confidence scores
smartScoring.impact: Unreliable confidence scores affecting user experience

problems: Multiple versions of processors (v1 and v2) coexisting
Heavy LLM dependency for basic operations
architecturalComplexity.impact: Difficult to maintain and extend functionality

problems: Unclear feedback during long LLM operations
Complex error states and recovery paths
Multiple UI modes (chat, form, visual) increasing complexity
Inconsistent handling of different user types
userExperienceGaps.impact: Confusing user experience for non-technical users

testCoverage.unit: Good coverage for clarification handling and LLM delegation
testCoverage.e2e: Comprehensive but failing due to network and state management issues
testCoverage.integration: Limited coverage for complex conversation flows

Simplify conversation state management to reduce complexity
Standardize confidence score representation (use percentages consistently)
Remove v1 processor and fully migrate to v2 LLM-driven architecture
shortTerm: Implement proper retry logic with exponential backoff
Add circuit breaker pattern for LLM API calls
Create clear user personas and optimize flows for each
longTerm: Consider event-driven architecture for conversation management
Implement caching layer for repeated LLM operations
Create abstraction layer for LLM provider independence
Design simplified conversation flow with fewer states

medium: Tight coupling between UI and conversation logic
